symptoms: High request volume exceeding rate thresholds from single or distributed IPs
possible_causes: Abnormal request rate / HTTP flood attack pattern targeting web application endpoints.
previous_actions: Temporarily block suspicious source IP and enforce global endpoint rate-limiting.
verification_steps: Monitor incoming traffic rate for 10 seconds to confirm request count drops below warning threshold.

symptoms: Input parameters containing SQL keywords such as UNION, SELECT, DROP, OR 1=1
possible_causes: Malicious payload attempt in HTTP request parameters attempting database manipulation.
previous_actions: Reject payload, log security alert, and temporarily restrict client identifier.
verification_steps: Verify subsequent requests with sanitized inputs process normally while malicious patterns are blocked.

symptoms: Multiple consecutive failed authentication attempts within short timeframe
possible_causes: Credential brute-force or dictionary attack targeting user authentication endpoints.
previous_actions: Lock targeted user account temporarily and reset failed attempt counter.
verification_steps: Attempt login to verify account state is locked and subsequent brute-force attempts are rejected instantly.

symptoms: Unauthorized attempt to elevate user role from normal_user to admin
possible_causes: Unauthorized role alteration request bypassing role-based access control (RBAC).
previous_actions: Deny role change request, revoke elevated token, and restore original user role.
verification_steps: Check active user session permissions to ensure role remains locked to normal_user.
